releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Add the Apache 2.0 LICENSE file by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/15
* Commit bun.lock by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/17
* Release in one dispatch: version from the tag (ship v0.6.0) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/19
* Register the bundled research-ledger skill from the plugin by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/22


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

## What's Changed
* Phase 1: topic scope, claim ledger, synthesis gate, Dewey export by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/1
* Phase 2: exploratory-call ratchet by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/2
* Deliver harness notes on MCP tool results by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/6
* fix: a challenge lowers the claim's confidence (#4) by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/7
* feat: publish injected tool args per callID for the supervisor by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/8
* Tell the model which args the harness filled in by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/9
* ci: release to npm through jflowers/ship's shared npm workflow by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/11
* ci: release through ship v0.5.0 by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/13

## New Contributors
* @jflowers made their first contribution in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-research-harness/commits/v0.1.0
